Name: Outdoor Greenhouse
Author: b3bb
Description:
[b]Grow crops and fruit trees in any season.[/b]
This mod removes seasonal restrictions, so you can plant and harvest crops year-round.
[b]Note:[/b] The mod applies to crops and trees only. Truffles are excluded!!

Manifest.Name: Farm Outdoor Greenhouse
Manifest.Description: Make the Farm behave like a greenhouse for crops (all seasons grow) while keeping outdoor visuals. Two modes: simple flag or Harmony patch.
